content.comment_body: Good evening, this is my first post and I'm unsure where else to ask. My issue is that I need to obtain the current time and date from a [product_name] [article_no] and send it to an HMI device, but I don't know if that's feasible. I'm familiar with doing this on a standard PLC, but I can't find a solution for [product_name]. I would appreciate any assistance or advice. Thank you.
Hello, I'm sorry, but this functionality isn't supported. The date and time format on [product_name] is not compatible with the format required by the HMI device. Regards,
I see, that's unfortunate for my application. I'll try to find an alternative solution. Thanks for your quick response!

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to extract the time and date information from a [product_name] [article_no] and display it on an HMI device. A respondent clarifies that this integration isn't possible, as the time and date formats between these two devices do not match. This limitation prevents users from being able to visualize synchronized time and date data across these industrial automation components.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates being able to easily transfer and display the date and time from the [product_name] device to the HMI for monitoring purposes.
